summary: Tested batch CV upload feature - all backend tests passed. Fixed a bug in batch-save endpoint where None name values caused 'NoneType has no attribute strip' error.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Batch CV upload feature tested and working. All roles (admin, recruiter, employer) can use batch-parse endpoint. Parallel processing confirmed working (~14s for 3 files). Fixed bug in batch-save where None name values caused error.
